name: mayo
description: Sauce meta-loop skill surface on top of the Sauce engine: /mayo:init binds a repo to a vault/board via .loop/config.json; status/review/propose/plan/execute/run/intake/block-review drive the board exclusively through the coordinator and card-intake rails, and /mayo:run can opt into the engine's shipped delivery-slice graph (sauce run). Requires the sauce install that ships the coordinator (brew or a local clone). Versioned by git commit — reload with /plugin marketplace update sauce.
